fee_notes: Royalty Fee is 5% of Gross Sales, paid weekly (currently Wednesday). A Non-Compliance Charge increases the Royalty Fee by 1 percentage point (to 6%) if franchisee is not in compliance. Brand Fund Contribution is 2% of Gross Sales, may be increased with 60 days notice, but total Required Marketing Spend (Brand Fund + local advertising + Local Advertising Co-Op) cannot exceed 6% of Gross Sales in aggregate (the "Marketing Cap"). Local Advertising Co-Op currently not assessed. Technology Fee currently not assessed but expected to be $250–$1,000/month. Learning Management System Fee currently not assessed but expected to be up to $1,000/month. Interest on overdue amounts is the lesser of 18% per year or the highest rate allowed by applicable law. NSF fee is $50 per returned check/draft plus collection costs. Transfer Fee is $5,000 plus attorneys' fees and inspection expenses ($1,000–$2,000). Renewal Fee is the higher of $7,500 or 25% of then-current initial franchise fee. Late Opening Fee is $100/day. Unauthorized Temporary Closure fee is 110% of average daily Royalty Fee for the prior week. Approval of Alternate Suppliers is $2,500 per request plus actual costs.
raw_excerpt:
Royalty Fee | 5% of Gross Sales | Weekly (currently on Wednesday) | Day of week is subject to change. See Note 2 for the definition of Gross Sales, Royalty Fee on revenue derived from sales of alcoholic beverages, and description of our current incentive program.
Brand Fund Contribution | 2% of Gross Sales; may change subject to the Marketing Cap | Weekly (currently on Wednesday) | We may, upon 60 days notice to you, increase the amount you must contribute to the Fund (as defined in Item 11); however, we cannot require you to contribute to the Fund (as defined in Item 11), spend on local marketing, and contribute to the Local Advertising Co-Op (as defined in Item 11) (collectively, the "Required Marketing Spend") an amount that exceeds 6% of Gross Sales, in the aggregate (the "Marketing Cap"). See Notes 2 and 3.
Local Advertising Co-Op | Currently not assessed, but may not exceed the Marketing Cap | As specified by the Co-Op | We may require you to pay this amount to us under certain circumstances. Your Local Advertising Co-Op contribution may change subject to the Marketing Cap. See Note 4.
Technology Fee | Currently not assessed but expected to be an amount in the range of $250 to $1,000 per month | As incurred | In addition to paying us the technology fee, we may require you to directly purchase or lease certain technology products and related services directly from our designated or approved vendors.
Non-Compliance Charge | Increase of one point to the rate of your Royalty Fee | As incurred | If you do not comply with your obligations under the Franchise Agreement, your Royalty Fee will be increased to 6% of Gross Sales until we have determined that you have cured your deficiencies.
